notes.title: Your website, your way
notes.line1: Choose whether search engines can link to your site and whether it shows in Find a couple.
notes.line2: The password row sits right there too, on the Website screen.

notes.title: Collect addresses, message guests, thank-you notes
notes.line1: A link and QR guests fill in with their address, from the Website screen.
notes.line2: Email a group of guests, and keep thank-you notes straight, from Guests.

notes.title: Three picks in your checklist
notes.line1: Every book-and-hire task shows three vendors from your city, free on your date first.
notes.line2: Tap one for the vendor, or See all to browse.

notes.title: Planning checklist and invitations
notes.line1: A checklist by months out, seeded from your date, with overdue in rose.
notes.line2: Printable invitation cards with a QR to your site; guests and budget as CSV from Account.

notes.title: Lazo video calls
notes.line1: Call any vendor from their thread. Your camera stays off until you turn it on.
notes.line2: Vendors on Pro can schedule a call with you, with reminders the day before.

notes.title: Meal choices on RSVPs
notes.line1: Guests pick a meal and note allergies when they RSVP.
notes.line2: Send the counts to your caterer in one tap from Guests.

notes.title: June drafts your listing
notes.line1: Tap Let June draft it under Bio and Services detail; she writes from your name, categories, markets and price.
notes.line2: Use it, try again, or keep yours.

notes.title: Home and travel markets
notes.line1: Pick the markets you serve at standard rates, and the ones where a travel fee may apply.
notes.line2: Couples searching in every one of them find you.

notes.title: A cleaner inbox
notes.line1: Lost threads leave the inbox; spam gets reported and the sender blocked.
notes.line2: Each lead says where it came from: Zola, The Knot, a forwarded email, your site.

notes.title: Forward your leads
notes.line1: Forward any Knot, Zola, WeddingWire or Instagram inquiry to leads@meetlazo.com from your sign-in email.
notes.line2: It lands in your inbox as a lead, with its source.

notes.title: Automations and exports
notes.line1: Every rule Lazo runs for you, in one place in Account.
notes.line2: Leads and payments as CSV, also from Account.

notes.title: Lazo video calls
notes.line1: Call a couple from the thread; their camera stays off until you allow it.
notes.line2: Schedule a call (Pro and Studio) with reminders the day before.
